title: Rav Assi bar Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.51b.15), saying: “Whatever is inside the kalkalin, even water and salt, is forbidden.” Hyman says he has found no other mention of him, and Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Shimi bar Chiyya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Assi bar Chiyya. [Heilprin’s Rav Assi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=619&lang=en) points readers to Ami bar Chiyya.
Hyman reports Rav Shimi bar Chiyya from Dikdukei Soferim and says he found no other mention of Rav Assi bar Chiyya.
